post.summary: Creates an account. Sign in afterwards.
Opens an admin session; requires the auth:admin:sign-in permission.
Exchanges a refresh token for a new pair. Each refresh token works once.
Ends the session of the refresh token.

get.summary: Returns the caller's account, roles and permissions.

post.summary: Changes the caller's password, ends all their sessions and opens a new one.

get.summary: Lists accounts, newest first; optionally only those whose e-mail address contains the search text.
Returns an account with its roles and lock state.

post.summary: Stops the account from signing in and ends its sessions. Not allowed on your own account.
Lets the account sign in again and lifts a lockout after failed sign-ins.

put.summary: Gives the account a role. Requires holding every permission of the role.

delete.summary: Takes a role away from the account. Requires holding every permission of the role; not allowed on your own account.

get.summary: Lists every role with its permissions and how many users hold it.

put.summary: Replaces the role's name and permissions. The administrator role cannot be changed.

delete.summary: Deletes the role and takes it away from its holders. The administrator role cannot be deleted.

get.summary: Lists every permission a role can hold.

post.summary: Adds a profile to the caller's account.

put.summary: Renames a profile or changes its age rating.

delete.summary: Removes a profile; the last one cannot be removed.

get.summary: Tells whether the caller's e-mail address is verified.

post.summary: Sends the caller a new verification link; earlier links stop working. Once a minute at most.
Verifies the e-mail address with the token from the link. Needs no sign-in; each token works once.
